finding: Temporal-style durable workflow semantics do not justify a new F2 runtime/state authority. The reusable invariant is the separation of stable logical operation identity from retry-attempt identity and of observed orchestration completion from physical external-effect exactly-once execution. F2 already encodes these separations in WP103/WP104/WP105 at component scope.
negative_result: Do not adopt Temporal Service/Event History as canonical F2 state or effect authority; doing so would create a competing durable state/effect surface.
architecture_delta: TEST_FIRST_ONLY: cross-layer lost-ACK/retry falsifier across existing delivery lifecycle, deferred causal return and UNKNOWN/effect interlock. One logical child result and delivery survive two transport attempts; ACK remains recipient-delivery evidence only; parent re-entry uses fresh causal identity and exact result digest; UNKNOWN external effects are never blindly replayed; no delivery/reentry event can mint completion.
